title: Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst
raw_text: Our Security Operations Center serves a diverse portfolio of global clients by monitoring, detecting, and responding to cybersecurity incidents 24x7 using a cutting-edge SIEM platform. This highly collaborative team of eight analysts works alongside threat intelligence, engineering, and compliance colleagues to defend a hybrid estate spanning AWS, Azure, and on-premise data centers. On any given day, you would be triaging security alerts in Splunk Enterprise 8.x, investigating suspicious login patterns with Microsoft Sentinel, and escalating confirmed threats to our incident response team according to a documented runbook. You will also perform routine log source tuning—partnering with network and cloud teams—to reduce noise by at least 30% while maintaining 100% coverage of critical assets. Beyond reactive work, you’re expected to draft concise incident reports for clients, suggesting remediation steps that frequently require coordination with product and DevOps teams to patch vulnerabilities or adjust firewall rules. Success in this role hinges on reducing mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) from 15 minutes to under 5 minutes and mean time to resolution (MTTR) from 4 hours to under 90 minutes within the first six months. While hands-on SOC experience is valued, we prioritize individuals who grasp the fundamentals of network traffic analysis, Windows and Linux security logs, and cloud-native alerting frameworks like GuardDuty. You will collaborate closely with penetration testers during red-team simulations and contribute to bi-weekly threat-hunting sessions leveraging Sigma rules and MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Growth opportunities include rotating through different SOC tiers to gain exposure to incident response, threat intelligence integration, or engineering specializations.

title: Cybersecurity Engineer - Threat Detection & Response
raw_text: This role sits within our rapidly evolving Security Engineering team, which builds and maintains the detection and response capabilities powering our enterprise SOC. The team—consisting of five engineers and two analysts—works closely with threat intelligence, DevOps, and product security to defend a cloud-first SaaS platform processing over 100K requests per second. Your core responsibility will be engineering custom detection content for our SIEM and EDR platforms, including alert correlation rules, behavioral analytics, and automated response playbooks. Daily tasks involve writing and testing Splunk ES macros, tuning Elastic Security 8.7 rules, and integrating new threat intelligence feeds into our detection pipeline, while ensuring alignment with MITRE ATT&CK and NIST frameworks. Each week you’ll participate in red-team/blue-team purple-teaming exercises to validate detection coverage, iterating on rules based on findings and producing post-exercise reports. Within six months, you are expected to reduce the number of high-severity undetected events by at least 50% and ensure 90% of critical alerts are auto-remediated via SOAR playbooks. Technical excellence is non-negotiable: you must be comfortable scripting in Python to parse logs at scale, automating SIEM content deployments with Ansible, and managing detection-as-code repositories. Collaboration is central to this role—you’ll work alongside incident responders to refine playbooks, advise product security teams on secure-by-design features, and partner with DevOps to implement infrastructure-as-code security guardrails. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment where precision and speed are equally valued, and demonstrates a passion for turning raw data into actionable insights.
